body:
I see the glow from the burning light casting shadows on the walls, illuminating only one small corner where we usually sit together. Fear grips me as I realize this could be a sign of trouble. My heart races, but the urge to protect us remains strong. 

I gather my courage and walk towards the beam of light, calling out softly, "It’s okay. Everything will be fine." As I approach, I notice my friends’ faces turn pale, their eyes filled with uncertainty. Their hands reach for mine instinctively, seeking comfort.  

The closeness between us now feels more intimate than ever before, like an unbreakable bond under threat. We stand side by side, not just physically, but also emotionally, knowing that together we can face whatever challenges lie ahead.
